name: Leomund's Secret Chest
description:
You attempt to send a lockable container to the ethereal plane. To cast this spell, you must be holding the container’s key in its lock. Roll Lore against a difficulty equal to the container’s length + width + height, in feet. On a pass, the container instantly phases out and remains on the ethereal plane indefinitely.

To recall the container, cast this spell again while holding the same key (you do not need to roll Lore to recall). The container teleports to your location and phases in, positioned so that the key is already in the lock.

The key still operates the lock normally when not casting the spell. If the key is broken or destroyed while the container is on the ethereal plane, the container remains there and cannot be recalled by this spell.
successes:
✨: You may recall this container as a half action and without spending the MP cost of this spell.

🌞: You may recall this container and return it to the ethereal plane as many times as you like by using a half action and without spending the MP cost of this spell.

💀: The spell is botched. The container is broken. Roll 1d8. On a 1, one of the items in the container, chosen at random, are also broken. Check a condition.
